$comment: Freqtrade config for the cross-check. Contains no credentials — the exchange block is present only because freqtrade requires one, and every run is a backtest against local files. See crosscheck/README.md.
$comment_sizing: A fixed 25 USDT stake against a deliberately huge wallet, with unlimited concurrent trades. The TypeScript engine backtests each symbol independently against its own 100 USD portfolio, so pairs never compete for capital there; an unbounded wallet reproduces that. Absolute P&L is therefore NOT the comparison metric — per-trade gross return % and exit reason are, and those are sizing-independent.
$comment_fees: 0.055% per side, matching simulatedTakerFeePercent in the TypeScript cross-check config. Both legs are taker in this comparison: post-only entries are disabled on the TypeScript side because freqtrade does not model a resting bid the same way, and that fill model would dominate the diff.
